personality_one_liner: A highly readable, fast, and structured cafe management tool that frames operational utility with warm terracotta accents and crisp native spacing.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around cards (lg/xl), with tighter grouping (sm) for dense POS items. Avoid accidental empty space.

do's: Use on sticky header tabs (e.g., POS categories).
Use on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it.
dont's: Never use on form fields or standard list rows.

screens.name: POS / Kasir
screens.purpose: A fast, touch-friendly point of sale interface for taking cafe orders.

states.empty: Illustration of a coffee cup with 'No items found in this category'.
states.error: Error loading menu with a retry button.

screens.layout: Responsive layout. On mobile: Top sticky scrollable category pills (glassmorphism), 2-column item grid, persistent sticky floating Cart summary CTA at bottom. On tablet/web: 3-col/4-col grid for items on the left, fixed Cart/Order panel on the right.

screens.name: Dashboard / Beranda
screens.purpose: High-level overview of roles, shift status, and key metrics.

states.empty: No active shift or data yet - prompt to Clock In.
states.error: Unable to fetch metrics with retry.

screens.layout: Single column on mobile (cards stack), multi-column grid on tablet/web using space-between and wrap. Cards use surfaceSecondary with border.

screens.name: Inventory / Gudang
screens.purpose: Manage stock across multiple locations (Gudang, Bar, Kitchen).

states.empty: Zero inventory items found, show 'Stock Kosong'.

screens.layout: List view with thumbnail, name, and robust stepper controls for stock adjustment. Status pills (brandTertiary for low stock warning) aligned to the right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Focus heavily on RESPONSIVE DESIGN: The POS screen must adapt from a stacked layout on mobile (grid + sticky bottom cart CTA) to a side-by-side layout on tablet/web (menu left, persistent cart right).
Use native system fonts without any font loading, preserving app speed.
Adopt '1 iOS-Native Clean' rules: highly readable, fast UI with solid grouping. Use surfaceSecondary for cards.
Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt, specifically for the POS steppers (+/- buttons) and checkout actions.
No indigo, purple, or blue! The primary brand accent is Terracotta (#D35400) indicating a warm cafe setting.
